Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What does the Thyrocare Food Intolerance Profile include?
The Thyrocare Food Intolerance Profile is a detailed diagnostic test that screens for intolerance to 218 different food items across various categories such as dairy, cereals, meats, seafood, vegetables, fruits, spices, and nuts. This test detects IgG antibodies in response to specific foods, helping identify potential causes of delayed allergic reactions, digestive discomfort, skin issues, headaches, and chronic fatigue. All tests are conducted at Thyrocare’s fully automated, NABL and ISO-certified laboratories to ensure high accuracy and reliable outcomes.
2. Who should consider the Thyrocare Food Intolerance Profile?
This profile is highly recommended for individuals who frequently suffer from bloating, stomach discomfort, skin rashes, migraines, or unexplained fatigue. It is also useful for those who are following elimination diets or want to make informed decisions about which foods might be contributing to chronic symptoms. Thyrocare’s Food Intolerance Profile serves as a powerful preventive tool for improving overall wellness through dietary awareness and management.
3. Is fasting required before taking the Thyrocare Food Intolerance Profile test?
Fasting is not necessary for this test. You can schedule it at any time during the day, making it convenient and flexible. Since this test analyzes immune responses to foods rather than metabolic functions, eating before the test does not affect the results.
4. How is the sample collected and processed by Thyrocare?
Thyrocare provides free home sample collection across India. Once your booking is confirmed, a trained and certified phlebotomist will visit your location at the scheduled time to collect a blood sample. The sample is then safely transported to Thyrocare’s central diagnostic laboratory, where it undergoes analysis using fully automated systems. The entire process ensures high accuracy and minimal human error.
5. What is the cost of the Thyrocare Food Intolerance Profile?
The Thyrocare Food Intolerance Profile is available at a competitive price of Rs 6,999. This includes testing for 218 food allergens, free home sample collection, and a comprehensive digital report sent via email and SMS. It is an affordable solution for those seeking to understand the root cause of unexplained health symptoms linked to food sensitivity.
6. When will I receive my Thyrocare test report?
You will typically receive your test report within 72 hours after sample collection. Thyrocare ensures prompt digital delivery of your results, enabling timely consultation with a healthcare professional to interpret the findings and plan your dietary strategy.
7. Why choose Thyrocare for food intolerance testing?
Thyrocare is one of India’s most trusted names in preventive healthcare diagnostics, offering quality services backed by over two decades of expertise. With its vast network for home sample collection, fully automated testing systems, and adherence to NABL and ISO standards, Thyrocare ensures accurate, affordable, and accessible health solutions. The Food Intolerance Profile is a valuable tool for individuals aiming to personalize their nutrition and address chronic health concerns through informed dietary changes.

Q: What is the Jaanch – Men’s Hairfall Screening Advanced?
Ans.
The Men’s Hairfall Screening Advanced is a doctor-recommended diagnostic package by Thyrocare that includes 47 essential parameters. It is designed to identify the underlying causes of hair loss in men by evaluating nutritional deficiencies, hormonal imbalances, thyroid dysfunction, and inflammation markers. This detailed analysis supports accurate diagnosis and effective treatment planning for hairfall issues.
Q: What tests are included in this profile?
Ans.
This package covers a wide range of parameters including thyroid profile (TSH, T3, T4), CBC, vitamin D and B12 levels, iron studies, ferritin, calcium, phosphorus, magnesium, and zinc. It also includes key hormonal and inflammatory markers like cortisol, dihydrotestosterone (DHT), sex hormone-binding globulin (SHBG), Anti-Nuclear Antibody (ANA), and C-Reactive Protein (CRP) to assess autoimmune or chronic inflammation-related causes of hair loss.
Q: Why is this test important for men experiencing hairfall?
Ans.
Hair loss in men can result from several causes, including nutritional deficiencies, stress, hormonal imbalances, or even autoimmune disorders. This test helps pinpoint the exact reason behind hairfall so that proper treatment—whether through supplements, medications, or lifestyle changes—can be started. Early diagnosis can prevent further hair loss and even reverse damage in many cases.
Q: Who should take this test?
Ans.
This test is ideal for men experiencing unexplained hair thinning, receding hairline, patchy hair loss, or a sudden increase in hair fall. It is especially recommended if there is a family history of baldness, or if lifestyle factors like stress, poor diet, or medical conditions may be contributing to the problem.
Q: Is fasting required before taking the test?
Ans.
Yes, fasting for 8–10 hours is recommended before sample collection for accurate assessment of blood sugar, hormone, and nutritional levels. Water is allowed during the fasting period.

A certified technician from Thyrocare will visit your home to collect the blood sample. BookMyTest offers free home sample collection across India, making the process convenient and hassle-free.
Q: How soon will I get the results?

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
What is the Hepatitis Panel by Thyrocare?
The Hepatitis Panel by Thyrocare is a diagnostic test package designed to screen for and detect hepatitis infections, including Hepatitis A, B, C, and E, along with liver function assessment.
Why should I take the Thyrocare Hepatitis Panel test?
If you experience symptoms like jaundice, fatigue, abdominal pain, or unexplained weight loss, or if you have a history of liver disease or possible exposure to hepatitis viruses, the Thyrocare Hepatitis Panel test is essential for timely diagnosis and treatment.
What tests are included in the Thyrocare Hepatitis Panel?
The Hepatitis Panel by Thyrocare typically includes tests for Hepatitis A IgM, Hepatitis B Surface Antigen (HBsAg), Hepatitis C Antibody (Anti-HCV), and other markers for comprehensive screening.
Is fasting required before taking the Thyrocare Hepatitis Panel test?
No, fasting is not required for the Thyrocare Hepatitis Panel test. However, it’s advisable to consult your doctor or the testing center for specific instructions.
How can I book the Thyrocare Hepatitis Panel test online?
You can book the Thyrocare Hepatitis Panel test easily through our website. Select the test, schedule a convenient time, and our home collection service will handle the rest.
What is the cost of the Thyrocare Hepatitis Panel test?
The cost of the Hepatitis Panel by Thyrocare varies depending on location and ongoing discounts. Visit our website or contact us to know the latest price and offers.
How long does it take to get results for the Thyrocare Hepatitis Panel test?
Test results are usually available within 24-48 hours and can be accessed online or delivered via email for your convenience.
Can the Thyrocare Hepatitis Panel detect all types of hepatitis?
Yes, the Hepatitis Panel by Thyrocare is designed to screen for major types of hepatitis, including A, B, C, and E, offering a comprehensive analysis of your liver health.
How is the Thyrocare Hepatitis Panel test beneficial?
The test aids in the early detection of hepatitis infections, helps monitor liver function, and supports timely medical intervention, ensuring better management of your health.
Why choose Thyrocare for the Hepatitis Panel test?
Thyrocare provides accurate, affordable, and reliable diagnostic services, with NABL-certified labs, home sample collection, and timely delivery of results, making it a trusted choice for the Hepatitis Panel test.

Ans.
The Thyrocare Metabolic Profile Basic is a comprehensive health check-up package that assesses your core metabolic functions. It covers essential parameters related to liver health, kidney function, blood sugar levels, lipid profile, and uric acid. This test is helpful in identifying early signs of lifestyle disorders such as diabetes, high cholesterol, and liver or kidney issues.
Q. Who should consider getting this test?
Ans.
This test is suitable for anyone looking to monitor their general health, especially those with a sedentary lifestyle, a family history of metabolic disorders, or symptoms like frequent fatigue, unexplained weight changes, or high blood pressure. It’s also recommended as a preventive health check-up for adults.
Q. What parameters are included in this test?

The package generally includes tests to evaluate liver function, kidney function, fasting blood sugar, cholesterol and lipid levels, and uric acid levels. The exact components may vary slightly depending on your location or lab processing.

Q. What kind of samples are collected for this test?
Ans.
A blood sample is required for this test. In some cases, a urine sample may also be requested depending on the specific version of the test offered.
Q. When will I receive my test results?
Ans.
You can expect to receive your test reports within 24 to 48 hours after your sample has been collected. The reports are usually shared via email, WhatsApp, or through an online portal.
Q. Can I book a home sample collection for this test?
Ans.
Yes, home sample collection is available in most Indian cities. A trained technician will visit your location at your chosen time to collect the sample safely and conveniently.
Q. Is a doctor’s prescription needed to take this test?
Ans.
No, you do not need a prescription to book this test. However, after receiving your report, it is advisable to consult a healthcare professional for interpretation and further guidance.
Q. How frequently should I take this test?
Ans.
For general health tracking, it is recommended to undergo this test once every year. If you already have a diagnosed metabolic condition such as diabetes or high cholesterol, your doctor may advise more frequent testing based on your health status.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
Q. What is the Thyrocare Infertility Profile Advanced test?
Ans.
The Infertility Profile Advanced is a detailed diagnostic package that assesses multiple hormonal and metabolic factors that can affect fertility in both men and women. This profile offers deeper insights compared to the basic version and is helpful in evaluating ovulation, ovarian reserve, thyroid health, and other hormonal imbalances that may interfere with conception.
Q. Who should consider this test?
Ans.
Couples who have been trying to conceive for more than six months without success should consider this test. It is especially beneficial for women with irregular periods, suspected PCOS, or past miscarriages, and for men with suspected low testosterone or sperm production issues. It is also a useful screening tool before planning assisted reproductive treatments like IVF or IUI.
Q. What tests are included in this package?
Ans.
This advanced profile typically includes a wide range of tests such as Follicle Stimulating Hormone (FSH), Luteinizing Hormone (LH), Prolactin, Estradiol (E2), Testosterone, Anti-Müllerian Hormone (AMH), TSH (Thyroid Stimulating Hormone), Free T3, Free T4, and additional tests that give a more comprehensive picture of reproductive health. AMH is particularly important for assessing ovarian reserve in women.
Q. Is fasting required for this test?
Ans.
Fasting is usually not required for infertility hormone tests. However, it is advisable to follow the lab’s instructions, as certain tests may need to be performed at a specific time in the menstrual cycle for women.
Q. What type of sample is collected?
Ans.
A blood sample is collected for this test. The sample is analysed to check various hormone levels that are critical for fertility and reproductive function.
Q. When will I receive my test results?
Ans.
Test results are typically available within 24 to 48 hours of sample collection. You will receive your reports digitally through email, WhatsApp, or the lab’s portal.
Q. Is home collection available for this test?
Ans.
Yes, Thyrocare offers convenient home sample collection in most Indian cities. A trained technician will collect your sample from home at your chosen date and time.
Q. Do I need a doctor’s prescription to book this test?
Ans.
No prescription is needed to book this test. However, consulting a fertility specialist or gynecologist after receiving the results is highly recommended for accurate interpretation and next steps.
Q. How often should I take this test?
Ans.
This test is usually done once during the fertility evaluation stage. Depending on your diagnosis and treatment plan, your doctor may suggest repeating some of the tests after a few months to track progress.

The
JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package by Thyrocare
is an advanced diagnostic screening package designed to evaluate important markers associated with
autoimmune disorders
. Autoimmune conditions develop when the immune system mistakenly reacts against the body`s own healthy cells and tissues. Because these disorders can affect different organs and often produce overlapping symptoms, laboratory testing plays an important role in their evaluation.
Autoimmune disorders may not always begin with one specific symptom. Some people experience
persistent joint pain, muscle aches, unexplained fatigue, recurring fever, skin rashes, swelling, morning stiffness, unusual weakness or other symptoms that continue despite routine treatment
. In such situations, a doctor may recommend autoimmune blood tests to investigate whether an abnormal immune response could be contributing to the symptoms.
The
Thyrocare JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package
brings together multiple investigations relevant to autoimmune assessment, making it suitable for people who require a more detailed evaluation than a routine health checkup. These tests can help identify antibodies and other laboratory abnormalities that may be associated with autoimmune activity.
Autoimmune testing may be particularly relevant when conditions such as
rheumatoid arthritis, systemic lupus erythematosus (SLE), Sjögren`s syndrome or other connective tissue and autoimmune disorders
are suspected. However, an abnormal antibody result alone does not confirm a particular autoimmune disease. Some antibodies can also be detected in people without an active autoimmune condition.
This is why the results of the
JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package from Thyrocare
should be interpreted together with your symptoms, physical examination, medical history and other investigations. Depending on the findings, your doctor may recommend consultation with a rheumatologist or another specialist and may request additional disease-specific tests.
The package can also be useful for individuals who already have an autoimmune condition when specific laboratory monitoring has been advised by their doctor.
With
Thyrocare home sample collection
available in serviceable locations, the JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package provides a convenient way to undergo a detailed autoimmune blood test without making an unnecessary trip to a diagnostic centre.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is the JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package by Thyrocare?
The JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package is a specialised blood testing package from Thyrocare designed to evaluate laboratory markers associated with autoimmune conditions. It can support doctors in investigating symptoms that may be caused by an abnormal immune response.
2. What are autoimmune diseases?
Autoimmune diseases occur when the immune system, which normally protects the body from infections, mistakenly targets the bodys own cells or tissues. Depending on the condition, this abnormal immune response may affect the joints, skin, muscles, glands, blood vessels or internal organs.
3. What symptoms may indicate the need for an autoimmune blood test?
Autoimmune testing may be considered when symptoms such as persistent joint pain, morning stiffness, unexplained fatigue, recurring fever, muscle pain, skin rashes, swelling or prolonged unexplained health problems are present. These symptoms can have many other causes, so a doctor should determine whether autoimmune testing is appropriate.
4. What conditions can the Thyrocare JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package help evaluate?
Depending on the markers included, autoimmune testing may assist in the evaluation of conditions such as rheumatoid arthritis, lupus (SLE), Sjögrens syndrome and other autoimmune or connective tissue disorders. The exact tests included in the package should be checked before booking.
5. Can a positive autoimmune test confirm that I have an autoimmune disease?
No. A positive antibody or abnormal autoimmune marker does not independently confirm a diagnosis. Some markers may occur in multiple autoimmune conditions and can occasionally be found in otherwise healthy individuals. Diagnosis requires correlation with symptoms, clinical examination and other investigations.
6. Can autoimmune disease be present even if some blood test results are normal?
Yes. Autoimmune diseases can be complex, and no single laboratory test can detect every autoimmune condition. A normal result does not always completely exclude an autoimmune disorder. If symptoms persist, your doctor may recommend additional or more specific investigations.
7. Is fasting required for the JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package by Thyrocare?
Fasting requirements depend on the exact investigations included in the package. Follow the preparation instructions provided when booking your Thyrocare test. Unless fasting is specifically advised, do not change medications or diet without consulting your doctor.
8. Who should consider the Thyrocare JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package?
The package may be considered by people with persistent symptoms suggestive of an autoimmune condition, individuals with a family or medical history that increases clinical suspicion, or patients specifically advised by a doctor to undergo detailed autoimmune screening.
9. What should I do if my autoimmune test results are abnormal?
Abnormal autoimmune results should be reviewed by a qualified doctor. Depending on your symptoms and the particular markers involved, you may be advised to undergo additional investigations or consult a rheumatologist or another appropriate specialist.
10. Can I book the JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package by Thyrocare with home sample collection?
Yes,
Thyrocare home sample collection
may be available in serviceable locations. This allows eligible patients to book the JAANCH Autoimmune Advanced Package online and have their blood sample collected conveniently at home.

The Thyrocare Jaanch Immunity Health Package includes a total of 60 crucial test parameters that assess immune response, inflammation levels, nutritional status, and organ health. This package is recommended for individuals who suffer from recurrent infections, low energy levels, delayed recovery from illness, or chronic stress. People recovering from viral infections or those with compromised immune responses can greatly benefit from this comprehensive assessment offered by Thyrocare.
3. Is fasting required before taking the Thyrocare Jaanch Immunity Health test?
Yes, a fasting period of 10 to 12 hours is recommended before sample collection. Only water should be consumed during this time. Fasting ensures accurate test results, particularly for blood glucose, liver enzymes, and lipid-related values, which could otherwise be affected by recent food intake.
4. How is the sample collected for the Thyrocare Jaanch Immunity Health test?
Thyrocare provides free home sample collection through trained phlebotomists who follow strict hygiene protocols. The technician will visit your home at a scheduled time to collect the blood sample, which is then securely transported to Thyrocare’s advanced diagnostic facility for testing. The labs are fully automated and operate under national and international quality standards for consistent accuracy.

Test reports are generally delivered within 24 to 48 hours after sample collection. Thyrocare shares the digital report securely via SMS and email, allowing you to conveniently review and consult with your healthcare provider.

Thyrocare is a leading diagnostic brand with over 25 years of experience in preventive healthcare. Known for its reliable, cost-effective, and advanced testing capabilities, Thyrocare operates fully automated laboratories accredited by NABL and ISO. With nationwide coverage and expert sample handling, Thyrocare ensures fast, accurate, and affordable testing. The Jaanch Immunity Health Package has been specifically designed to help individuals track their immune function and take proactive steps to stay healthy.

The
JAANCH Male Infertility Package by Thyrocare
is a specialised diagnostic screening package designed to evaluate important health and hormonal factors that may be associated with
male fertility problems
. Male infertility can have several possible causes, including hormonal imbalance, reproductive health conditions, lifestyle factors, certain medical conditions and nutritional issues.
The
Thyrocare JAANCH Male Infertility Package
may be useful for men who have been trying to conceive with their partner without success or who have been advised to undergo a fertility evaluation. Hormones play an important role in
sperm production, testosterone regulation and normal reproductive function
, and abnormalities in these markers may provide useful information during infertility assessment.
Male fertility problems may not always cause noticeable symptoms. However, some men may experience
reduced sexual desire, erectile difficulties, changes in testicular size, reduced facial or body hair, unexplained fatigue or other symptoms associated with hormonal imbalance
.
This package provides laboratory information that can support a broader male infertility evaluation. However, blood tests alone cannot determine every cause of infertility. Depending on the results and medical history, a doctor may also recommend
semen analysis, physical examination, ultrasound, genetic testing or other specialised investigations
.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is the JAANCH Male Infertility Package by Thyrocare?
The
Thyrocare JAANCH Male Infertility Package
is a specialised diagnostic package that evaluates important laboratory markers relevant to male reproductive and hormonal health. It can form part of a broader investigation when a couple is experiencing difficulty conceiving.
2. Who should consider the JAANCH Male Infertility Package?
The package may be considered by men who have been unable to conceive with their partner despite regular unprotected intercourse, have symptoms of hormonal imbalance, have known reproductive health concerns, or have been advised to undergo fertility testing by a doctor.
3. What can cause infertility in men?
Male infertility can have many possible causes, including problems with sperm production or quality, hormonal imbalance, varicocele, infections, genetic conditions, certain medications, smoking, excessive alcohol consumption, obesity and other lifestyle or medical factors.
4. Can hormone imbalance affect male fertility?
Yes. Hormones are involved in testosterone production and sperm development. Abnormalities in certain reproductive hormones may interfere with normal sperm production or sexual function, which is why hormonal assessment can be useful in selected infertility cases.
5. Is a blood test enough to diagnose male infertility?
No. Male infertility evaluation usually involves more than blood testing. A
semen analysis
is commonly an important part of fertility assessment because it evaluates factors such as sperm count, movement and morphology. Your doctor may recommend additional investigations depending on the findings.
6. When should a man get tested for infertility?
Fertility evaluation is commonly considered when pregnancy has not occurred after
12 months of regular unprotected intercourse
. Earlier evaluation may be appropriate when there are known fertility risk factors or when the female partner is 35 years or older.
7. Is fasting required for the Thyrocare JAANCH Male Infertility Package?
Preparation requirements depend on the exact tests included in the package. Follow the instructions provided with your
Thyrocare test booking
. Certain hormonal tests may also have preferred collection timings, so follow the recommended sample collection schedule.
8. Does the JAANCH Male Infertility Package include semen analysis?
Do not assume that semen analysis is included unless it is specifically mentioned in the current package test list. Blood-based fertility testing and semen analysis evaluate different aspects of male fertility and may both be recommended during an infertility work-up.
9. What should I do if my male fertility test results are abnormal?
Abnormal results should be discussed with a doctor, urologist, andrologist or fertility specialist. The results need to be interpreted alongside semen analysis, medical history, physical examination and other investigations before determining the possible cause of infertility.
10. Is Thyrocare home sample collection available for the JAANCH Male Infertility Package?
Thyrocare home sample collection
may be available for eligible blood investigations in serviceable locations. If semen analysis or another specialised sample is required, specific sample collection instructions or a centre visit may be necessary.

Wellness Male Package is a comprehensive preventive health checkup package designed for men to screen lifestyle disorders, heart risk, cancer risk indicators and major organ health. 2. Who should opt for this package?
This package is ideal for men who want advanced preventive monitoring, those with stressful and sedentary lifestyle, irregular food habits, weight gain, fatigue, smoking or alcohol exposure, and people with family history of diabetes, cholesterol issues, thyroid imbalance or cardiac disease.
3. What tests are included in the Wellness Male Package?

Cancer markers help in early preventive evaluation and risk screening. While they do not confirm cancer alone, they support early identification of abnormal trends and help doctors decide if further testing is needed.

Cardiac risk markers provide deeper insight into heart health and early cardiovascular risk. They help identify hidden inflammation and heart-related risk even before symptoms appear, making this package useful for lifestyle-related screening.
6. Why is toxic elements testing included in this package?
Toxic elements testing checks exposure to harmful metals and toxins that may enter the body through air, water, food or workplace environment. Monitoring these helps protect long-term organ health and supports better energy and overall wellness.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is the Metropolis TruHealth Mind & Body Premium package?
The Metropolis TruHealth Mind & Body Premium is a holistic wellness checkup that links physical health with mental wellbeing in a single 80+ parameter assessment. Unlike a standard full body checkup that looks only at organ function, this package also screens stress-related hormones, mood-influencing nutrients (Vitamin B12, Vitamin D, iron, folate), thyroid markers and inflammation indicators that directly affect energy, focus, mood and sleep. It is processed at Metropolis Healthcares NABL-accredited laboratory and bookable with free home collection through bookmytest.co.in.
2. How is the Mind & Body Premium different from a regular full body checkup?
A regular full body checkup screens vital organs — heart, liver, kidney, thyroid and blood sugar. The Mind & Body Premium adds an entirely separate layer focused on the biological factors that influence mental wellbeing, including stress-response markers, mood-affecting nutrient deficiencies and inflammation markers linked to fatigue and low mood. This dual scope is why Indian professionals, founders and high-stress workers increasingly choose this package — it answers both "are my organs healthy" and "why am I feeling this way" in a single report.
3. Which stress and mood-related parameters are included in this package?
The Mind & Body Premium typically screens stress-influenced hormones (such as thyroid and cortisol-axis indicators), mood-linked nutrient levels (Vitamin D, Vitamin B12, folate, iron, ferritin), inflammation markers (HsCRP), homocysteine for cognitive risk, and full thyroid profile — all of which are biologically tied to energy, focus, sleep and emotional regulation. Alongside this, the standard organ panels for heart, liver, kidney, diabetes and CBC are included. The exact 80+ parameter list is published on the package page on bookmytest.co.in.
4. Can this package help identify biological causes of brain fog, low mood or chronic fatigue?
Yes, this is one of the strongest use cases for the Mind & Body Premium. Persistent brain fog, low mood, poor concentration and unexplained fatigue often have underlying biological drivers — low Vitamin B12, low Vitamin D, low ferritin, subclinical hypothyroidism, elevated inflammation or disturbed stress hormones. These conditions are very common in Indian adults yet routinely missed because no single basic test captures them all. Detecting and correcting these biological factors often produces noticeable improvement in mental clarity and energy within weeks.
5. Is the Mind & Body Premium useful for burnout or workplace mental fatigue?
Yes. Burnout is not purely psychological — chronic work stress alters cortisol patterns, depletes B-vitamins, lowers Vitamin D from indoor work, raises systemic inflammation and can disturb thyroid function. The Metropolis TruHealth Mind & Body Premium screens for these biological markers of stress burden, which is why it is increasingly used by Indian corporate professionals, founders, IT employees, doctors and consultants who recognise the early signs of burnout. The report gives a measurable baseline that can be improved through targeted nutrition, sleep, recovery and medical guidance.
6. Does this package screen sleep-related biological markers?
Indirectly, yes. Sleep quality is closely tied to thyroid function, Vitamin D status, magnesium levels, iron stores, blood sugar regulation and inflammation — all of which are evaluated through the Mind & Body Premium panel. Persistent poor sleep despite good sleep hygiene often reflects one or more of these biological imbalances rather than a behavioural problem. While the package does not include a sleep study, it is a strong first step to identify whether nutritional, hormonal or metabolic factors are contributing to disturbed sleep before considering specialist evaluation.
7. Who should consider booking the Mind & Body Premium package?
This package is ideal for Indian adults aged 25 to 55 in high-cognitive-load or high-stress roles — IT professionals, doctors, founders, consultants, finance and creative professionals, students preparing for competitive exams, caregivers, and parents balancing work with childcare. It is also valuable for anyone experiencing persistent fatigue, poor concentration, low mood, sleep disturbance or unexplained weight changes despite a normal lifestyle. Adults already in therapy or considering psychiatric consultation also benefit, as biological baseline data complements clinical mental health care.
8. How is mental wellbeing biologically connected to physical health?
Mental and physical health share the same biological foundation — hormones, neurotransmitter precursors, nutrients and inflammation. Low Vitamin D is consistently linked to depressive symptoms; Vitamin B12 deficiency affects memory and mood; subclinical thyroid disorder mimics depression; chronic inflammation is associated with low mood and brain fog; and disturbed cortisol patterns affect both sleep and immunity. By screening these markers together, the Metropolis TruHealth Mind & Body Premium provides a measurable, evidence-based view of the body systems that shape mental wellbeing.
9. Will this package replace seeing a psychologist or psychiatrist?
No, and this is important to be clear about. The Mind & Body Premium does not diagnose or treat psychiatric conditions like depression, anxiety disorders or bipolar disorder, and it is not a substitute for mental health professionals. What it does is identify biological factors that can either cause or worsen mental wellbeing symptoms. The ideal approach is to use the report as complementary input — share it with both your general physician and your mental health professional so that biological, psychological and lifestyle dimensions are addressed together.
10. How should I interpret and act on my Mind & Body Premium report?
The report uses Metropoliss colour-coded format — green for normal, yellow for borderline, red for out-of-range. A complimentary doctor consultation is typically included with bookings on bookmytest.co.in, which is particularly valuable for this package because interpreting stress, nutritional and hormonal markers together requires clinical context. Most flagged values are reversible through targeted supplementation, structured sleep, dietary changes, sunlight exposure and stress management. Repeat testing after 3 to 6 months helps measure whether interventions are working.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
What is the Thyrocare TruHeart Platinum test package?
The Thyrocare TruHeart Platinum package is an advanced cardiac risk assessment profile that includes lipid parameters, Apolipoproteins, inflammatory markers, and cardiac-specific risk indicators. It helps evaluate overall heart health and detect early signs of cardiovascular issues.
Who should opt for the TruHeart Platinum test?
This test is recommended for individuals with a family history of heart disease, high cholesterol levels, diabetes, hypertension, obesity, smoking habits, or those experiencing chest discomfort, fatigue, or shortness of breath. It is also helpful for preventive heart screening.
What parameters are included in the TruHeart Platinum package?
The package includes Lipid Profile (2), Apolipoprotein A1, Apolipoprotein B, ApoB/ApoA1 ratio, Lipoprotein(a), Homocysteine, hs-CRP, and Lp-PLA2. These markers help assess cholesterol balance, inflammation, and risk of plaque formation in arteries.
Is fasting required before taking the Thyrocare TruHeart Platinum test?
Yes, fasting for 10 to 12 hours is generally recommended to ensure accurate lipid and cardiac marker readings.
How are the samples collected for this test by Thyrocare?
Thyrocare offers convenient home sample collection by trained technicians. A small blood sample is collected and processed in Thyrocare’s fully automated and certified laboratories.
How long does it take to receive the reports?
Reports are usually available within 24 to 48 hours and are delivered digitally via email or SMS, ensuring quick and easy access.
What makes the TruHeart Platinum package useful?
This package offers a comprehensive assessment of heart health by checking cholesterol levels, inflammation markers, and artery health indicators. It helps detect early risks and supports timely medical intervention.
Can this test help prevent future heart issues?
Yes, early detection of abnormal lipid levels, inflammation, and plaque risk markers can help individuals make lifestyle changes or seek medical advice, reducing the chances of future heart complications.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is the Metropolis TruHealth Comprehensive Plus package?
Metropolis TruHealth Comprehensive Plus is a wide-spectrum unisex health checkup curated for Indian adults aged 35 to 55 who carry more than one lifestyle risk factor — such as a desk job combined with irregular sleep, occasional drinking and a family history of metabolic disease. It evaluates 70+ parameters in a single blood and urine sample, covering all major organ systems including pancreas and electrolyte balance, which most mid-tier packages skip. It is processed at Metropolis Healthcares NABL-accredited laboratory and bookable with free home collection through bookmytest.co.in.
2. Who specifically should choose Comprehensive Plus over other Metropolis packages?
Comprehensive Plus is the right choice for Indian adults who feel that a basic vital-organ checkup isnt deep enough, but a gender-specific premium package isnt necessary either. It is particularly suited for people aged 35 to 55 with multiple co-existing risk factors, those managing borderline values from previous reports, individuals on long-term medication, post-illness recovery cases, and anyone wanting a single annual baseline that genuinely replaces four to five separate tests. Senior citizens and people with very specific concerns may need an even deeper specialised package.
3. What is the difference between Vital Plus and Comprehensive Plus?
The Vital Plus package focuses on essential vital-organ screening with around 60 parameters and is built for first-time testers aged 25 to 45. Comprehensive Plus expands the scope to 90+ parameters, adding pancreatic function, electrolyte panel, expanded iron studies, additional vitamins and minerals, deeper cardiac risk markers and inflammation markers like HsCRP. It is designed for adults in the 35 to 55 window when subtle metabolic shifts begin and require closer tracking. As a rule of thumb, Vital Plus is your entry baseline; Comprehensive Plus is your mid-life annual standard.
4. Does Comprehensive Plus include cardiac risk assessment beyond basic cholesterol?
Yes. Beyond the standard Lipid Profile, Metropolis TruHealth Comprehensive Plus typically adds high-sensitivity CRP (HsCRP), which measures low-grade systemic inflammation linked to heart disease, and expanded lipid breakdown including non-HDL and triglyceride-to-HDL ratio. For Indian adults — who tend to develop coronary artery disease a decade earlier than Western populations — this layered cardiac assessment catches risk that a basic cholesterol number alone misses. Anyone with a family history of heart disease, hypertension or diabetes benefits from this deeper cardiac view.
5. Is Comprehensive Plus a good choice after recovering from a major illness or COVID-19?
Yes, and it is one of the most common reasons Indian adults book this specific package. Post-illness recovery — including post-COVID, post-hospitalisation, post-surgery or recovery from prolonged fever — can leave behind subtle changes in liver enzymes, kidney function, electrolytes, iron stores, blood counts and inflammatory markers. The 70+ parameter scope of Comprehensive Plus covers all of these in one sample, helping you confirm whether your body has returned to baseline. Most physicians recommend post-recovery testing around the 6 to 12 week mark.
6. Can Comprehensive Plus be used as a pre-surgery or pre-medication baseline?
Yes, the package is well suited as a personal baseline before starting any long-term medication, hormone therapy, weight-loss intervention or planned non-emergency surgery. The breadth of parameters — covering liver, kidney, electrolytes, complete blood count, glucose, thyroid and inflammation — gives a strong reference point that your treating doctor can compare against follow-up reports. This makes it easier to detect any medication-induced changes early and adjust therapy. The report should always be shared with your treating physician rather than self-interpreted in such cases.
7. Can I gift the Metropolis TruHealth Comprehensive Plus package to my parents through bookmytest.co.in?
Yes, gifting preventive health checkups to parents and in-laws is one of the fastest-growing booking categories on bookmytest.co.in, particularly during festive seasons, birthdays and parents day. You can book the Comprehensive Plus package using your parents name, mobile number and home address, schedule the Metropolis phlebotomist visit at their convenience, and the digital report is delivered directly to their registered mobile so they retain full privacy. The complimentary doctor consultation is also extended to them — making it a thoughtful and clinically meaningful gift.
8. How often should adults aged 35 to 55 take a comprehensive health checkup?
Annually, as a non-negotiable health habit. The 35 to 55 window is when most lifestyle conditions in Indian adults move from invisible to clinical — borderline thyroid becomes overt hypothyroidism, fatty liver progresses to NASH, pre-diabetes converts to Type 2 diabetes, and LDL slowly damages arteries. Annual testing through Metropolis TruHealth Comprehensive Plus builds a year-on-year trend line that catches these conversions early. Adults already managing one chronic condition or with a strong family history should consider testing every six months instead of annually.
9. How does Comprehensive Plus compare to a typical corporate health checkup?
Corporate health checkups
offered by Indian employers usually cover 40 to 60 parameters and are designed to meet a baseline standard across a large workforce — they are not tailored to your personal risk profile. The
Metropolis TruHealth Comprehensive Plus
offers 70+ parameters with significantly deeper coverage of cardiac risk, electrolytes, iron and inflammation, plus a complimentary doctor consultation for personalised interpretation. For adults who want a genuinely individualised annual assessment rather than a generic workplace check, Comprehensive Plus is the stronger and more clinically useful option.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female package?
The Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female is an advanced preventive health checkup designed for Indian women aged 30 and above, especially those with a family history of illness or a higher lifestyle risk profile. It evaluates 80+ parameters in a single blood and urine sample, covering heart, liver, kidney, thyroid, diabetes, anaemia, bone health, hormonal balance, key vitamins and cancer-screening markers. The package is processed at Metropolis Healthcares NABL-accredited laboratory and bookable online with free home collection through bookmytest.co.in.
2. What tests are included in Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female?
The TruHealth ProActive Female package by Metropolis includes Complete Blood Count (CBC), Lipid Profile, Liver Function Test (LFT), Kidney Function Test (KFT), Thyroid Profile (T3, T4, TSH), HbA1c and Fasting Blood Sugar, Vitamin D 25-Hydroxy, Vitamin B12, Iron Studies, Calcium, HsCRP for cardiac inflammation, hormonal markers and a complete Urine Routine examination. The exact 80+ parameter list, normal ranges and sample Metropolis report are visible on the package page on bookmytest.co.in before booking.
3. How is ProActive Female different from the regular Active Female package?
The ProActive Female package is the upgraded, more comprehensive version of the Active Female checkup. While the Active Female covers around 70 parameters focused on core metabolic and nutritional health, the ProActive Female adds extra cancer-screening markers, expanded hormonal panels, deeper cardiac risk assessment and additional bone-health indicators — taking the total to 80+ parameters. It is recommended for women above 30, women with a family history of cancer, diabetes or thyroid disease, and those wanting a deeper annual screening.
4. Why is this Metropolis package recommended for Indian women?
Indian women face a unique combination of high hypothyroidism prevalence, widespread iron-deficiency anaemia, very high Vitamin D deficiency, early-onset metabolic syndrome and rising rates of breast and cervical cancer. The Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female package is curated by Metropolis pathologists to screen exactly these high-prevalence conditions in a single sample. It is particularly valuable for women with a family history of cancer, diabetes, thyroid disorder or heart disease, and for women approaching perimenopause.
5. Is fasting required for the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female test?
Yes, a 10 to 12 hour overnight fast is required. Fasting is essential for accurate lipid profile, fasting glucose and insulin readings, which are directly affected by recent food intake. Plain water is allowed and recommended during the fasting window. Continue your prescription medication unless your doctor specifies otherwise. Avoid alcohol for 24 hours and heavy exercise for 12 hours before the Metropolis phlebotomist arrives, as both can temporarily alter liver enzymes and other key readings.
6. Can I take the Metropolis ProActive Female test during my period?
You can, but a few parameters may be affected. Haemoglobin and ferritin readings can be marginally lower during menstruation, and inflammatory markers like HsCRP may be slightly elevated. For the most accurate results, schedule the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female test for the week after your period ends. If your cycle is irregular or your booking is time-sensitive, proceeding is still fine — just inform the phlebotomist so the report can be interpreted accurately by your physician.
7. At what age should Indian women take the ProActive Female checkup?
The Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female package is ideal for Indian women from age 30 onwards, especially with a family history of illness, sedentary work, irregular cycles, BMI above 25 or post-pregnancy. From age 40, with menopause approaching, the expanded hormonal and bone-health panels become particularly valuable. Annual repeat testing helps build a personal baseline so subtle drift in TSH, ferritin, HbA1c or Vitamin D is caught early and treated before it progresses to clinical disease.
8. How long does it take to get the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female report?
Reports are delivered within 24 hours of sample pickup. Samples collected in the early morning slot typically reach the Metropolis processing laboratory the same day, with digital reports emailed and sent on WhatsApp by the next evening. A few specialised parameters like Vitamin B12 or certain hormonal markers may need an additional 12 hours. You can also download the report anytime from your bookmytest.co.in dashboard or the Metropolis TruHealth portal using your registered mobile number.
9. Is Metropolis a trusted lab for preventive checkups in India?
Yes. Metropolis Healthcare is among Indias most respected diagnostic chains, operating NABL-accredited and ISO-certified laboratories, with a senior panel of pathologists and decades of clinical reputation. The TruHealth series is designed in-house by Metropolis specialists and is widely used in corporate wellness, insurance health checks and individual preventive care across India. Booking the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female through bookmytest.co.in gives you the same lab quality with transparent partner pricing and zero hidden home-collection charges.
10. Is home sample collection available across India for this package?
Yes, free home sample collection by trained Metropolis phlebotomists is available across 2,000+ pincodes covering all major metro cities, tier-2 cities and most tier-3 towns in India. After booking on bookmytest.co.in, a female phlebotomist (on request) arrives at your address in a 2-hour slot of your choosing, ideally between 6 AM and 10 AM for fasting samples. There are no extra charges for the visit, report generation or digital delivery — pricing remains transparent across the country.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What makes the Metropolis TruHealth Expert Female the most advanced womens checkup in India?
The Expert Female package is the top tier in the Metropolis TruHealth series, built for Indian women aged 35 and above who want depth rather than just coverage. Beyond the standard heart, liver, kidney and thyroid panels, it adds advanced cancer-screening markers, an allergy panel, expanded hormonal indicators, inflammatory markers and detailed bone-health assessment in a single 90+ parameter sample. It is the closest equivalent to a corporate executive health check, but bookable individually online through bookmytest.co.in with free home collection.
2. Does the Metropolis Expert Female package include cancer screening?
Yes, the package includes advanced cancer-screening biomarkers relevant to Indian women, helping flag early biological changes long before symptoms appear. These markers are not a diagnosis on their own — they work as an early-warning layer alongside clinical examinations like mammography and Pap smear, both of which should still be done separately as per age guidelines. Women with a family history of breast, ovarian or cervical cancer benefit the most from this annual screening combination.
3. Which allergy parameters are tested in the Expert Female package?
The Metropolis TruHealth Expert Female package includes an allergy screening panel that helps identify whether unexplained symptoms — chronic skin rash, recurrent sinus issues, persistent cough, food sensitivities, joint pain or gut discomfort — could be allergy-driven rather than infection-driven. This is increasingly relevant for Indian women aged 35+, where allergic and autoimmune presentations rise sharply. Specific allergen testing can then be ordered as a follow-up based on which broad category is flagged.
4. How does this package help women going through perimenopause and menopause?
Perimenopause typically begins between 38 and 45 in Indian women and brings symptoms like irregular periods, sleep disruption, mood changes, weight gain, hair fall, fatigue and palpitations — often confused with thyroid disorder or stress. The Expert Female package screens thyroid, key hormones, iron, Vitamin D, calcium and cardiac risk markers together, which is the exact combination needed to differentiate perimenopausal changes from other treatable conditions. Annual testing through this phase is strongly advised.
5. Is the Metropolis Expert Female package suitable as an executive or corporate health check?
Yes. The 90+ parameter depth, NABL-accredited Metropolis processing and free home collection make this package directly comparable to executive health checks priced two to three times higher at hospital-based diagnostic centres. Senior professionals, founders and women in leadership roles use it as an annual baseline because it can be done at home over a weekend without taking time off, and the digital report is ready within 48 hours for sharing with a personal physician.
6. How often should the Expert Female checkup be repeated?
Annually for most women aged 35+, and every six months for women with a confirmed family history of cancer, autoimmune disease, diabetes or thyroid disorder, or those on long-term medication for hypertension, PCOS or hormonal therapy. The value of the Expert Female package compounds with repetition — a single report shows your current state, but two to three reports over consecutive years reveal trends in hormonal balance, bone density indicators, inflammation and metabolic markers that no one-time test can show.
7. What signs indicate I should upgrade from a basic checkup to the Expert Female?
Persistent fatigue despite normal basic reports, recurrent infections, unexplained weight changes, irregular cycles after age 35, family history of cancer or autoimmune disease, post-pregnancy symptoms that have not resolved, suspected hormonal imbalance, or any "everything is normal but I dont feel well" situation. Basic packages screen for common deficiencies; the Expert Female package screens for the deeper, often-missed causes — hormonal, allergic, autoimmune and inflammatory — that explain why symptoms persist when standard reports look fine.
8. Will Metropolis provide a doctor consultation with the Expert Female report?
Yes, a complimentary specialist consultation is typically included with the Metropolis TruHealth Expert Female package booked through bookmytest.co.in. Given the depth of parameters — especially hormonal, cancer-screening and allergy markers — interpretation by a qualified physician is strongly recommended rather than self-reading. The consultation helps you understand which borderline values matter, which require lifestyle correction, and which need a follow-up specialist referral to a gynaecologist, endocrinologist or oncologist.
9. Can the Expert Female package replace a gynaecological examination?
No, and it is important to be clear about this. The Metropolis TruHealth Expert Female package is a powerful blood-and-urine-based screening tool, but it does not replace clinical examinations like a Pap smear, pelvic exam, breast clinical examination, mammography, transvaginal ultrasound or bone-density DEXA scan. The ideal preventive strategy combines this annual blood panel with the imaging and clinical tests your gynaecologist recommends based on your age, history and findings.
10. How is pricing decided for the Metropolis TruHealth Expert Female on bookmytest.co.in?
Pricing on bookmytest.co.in reflects Metropoliss official partner rate for the TruHealth Expert Female package and is consistent across all serviceable Indian pincodes — there is no surge pricing by city. The price includes free home sample collection by a trained Metropolis phlebotomist, central laboratory processing at the NABL-accredited Metropolis facility, digital report delivery on email and WhatsApp, and a complimentary doctor consultation. The live, current price is always shown on the package page before booking confirmation.

It covers 70+ parameters in a single blood and urine sample, including male-specific markers like total testosterone and Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA), along with full panels for heart, liver, kidney, thyroid, diabetes, complete blood count, vitamins and cancer-screening markers. 2. What tests are included in the Metropolis TruHealth Active Male package?
The TruHealth Active Male package by Metropolis includes Complete Blood Count (CBC), Lipid Profile, Liver Function Test (LFT), Kidney Function Test (KFT), Thyroid Profile (T3, T4, TSH), HbA1c and Fasting Blood Sugar, Vitamin D 25-Hydroxy, Vitamin B12, Iron Studies, Total Testosterone, Prostate-Specific Antigen (PSA), HsCRP for cardiac inflammation, and a complete Urine Routine examination. The exact parameter list, normal ranges and a sample Metropolis report are visible on the package page on bookmytest.co.in before booking.
3. Why is testosterone testing important for Indian men?
Testosterone influences energy, muscle mass, fat distribution, libido, mood, sleep quality and bone density. Low testosterone in Indian men is increasingly being diagnosed even in the 30s, driven by obesity, sleep deprivation, chronic stress and metabolic syndrome. Symptoms include persistent fatigue, reduced gym performance, abdominal weight gain, loss of morning erections and irritability. The Metropolis TruHealth Active Male package includes a morning total testosterone test that confirms whether levels are below the normal adult male range of roughly 300 to 1,000 ng/dL.
4. What does the PSA test in this package detect?
PSA, or Prostate-Specific Antigen, is a protein produced by the prostate gland. Elevated levels can indicate benign prostate enlargement, prostatitis or, in some cases, prostate cancer. The normal range is generally below 4 ng/mL, though it varies with age. PSA screening through the Metropolis TruHealth Active Male package is particularly important for men above 45, men above 40 with a family history of prostate cancer, and those experiencing urinary symptoms such as frequent night-time urination, weak stream or incomplete bladder emptying.
5. Is fasting required for the Metropolis TruHealth Active Male test?
Yes, a 10 to 12 hour overnight fast is required. Fasting is essential for accurate lipid profile, fasting glucose, insulin and testosterone readings, all of which are affected by recent food intake or time of day. Plain water is allowed and recommended during the fasting window. Continue your prescription medication unless your doctor advises otherwise, and avoid alcohol for 24 hours and intense gym workouts for 12 hours before the Metropolis phlebotomist arrives for sample collection.
6. At what age should Indian men start taking the Metropolis full body checkup?
Indian men should begin annual preventive health checkups from age 25, especially with a desk job, irregular sleep, family history of diabetes, heart disease or thyroid disorder, or a BMI above 25. From age 40, PSA and cardiac risk markers become particularly important. The Metropolis TruHealth Active Male package is built around exactly this profile, combining metabolic, hormonal and male-specific screening in a single sample. Annual repeat testing helps build a personal baseline so any drift in HbA1c, LDL or testosterone is caught early.

Yes. Metropolis Healthcare is one of Indias largest and most respected diagnostic chains, with NABL-accredited laboratories, decades of clinical reputation and a panel of senior pathologists. The TruHealth series of preventive packages is curated by Metropolis specialists and is widely used by corporate health programmes, insurance partners and individual customers across India. There are no hidden charges for the visit, report generation or digital delivery anywhere in India.
10. What should I do if my Metropolis TruHealth report shows borderline values?
Borderline values are early warnings rather than disease diagnoses, and most of them are reversible through lifestyle changes. A fasting glucose of 105 mg/dL, an HbA1c of 5.8%, an LDL of 110 mg/dL or a testosterone of 290 ng/dL are all borderline and respond well to weight reduction, strength training, improved sleep, reduced alcohol and targeted supplementation. Consult a physician, repeat the Metropolis test in three months, and track the trend rather than reacting to a single value.

3. Why is thyroid testing important for Indian women?
Hypothyroidism is significantly more common in Indian women than men, with prevalence rising sharply after the age of 30 and around pregnancy or menopause. It can silently cause fatigue, weight gain, hair fall, irregular periods, infertility, low mood and dry skin — symptoms often mistaken for everyday stress. A simple TSH, T3 and T4 blood test confirms the diagnosis. Untreated hypothyroidism affects cholesterol, fertility and heart health, which is why annual thyroid screening is strongly advised for adult women.
4. Why is iron deficiency screening important for women?
Iron-deficiency anaemia is one of the most under-diagnosed conditions in Indian women, affecting more than half of women of reproductive age. Heavy menstrual flow, pregnancy, breastfeeding and vegetarian diets all increase the risk. Symptoms include persistent tiredness, breathlessness on stairs, hair fall, brittle nails, pale skin and poor concentration. The Active Female package tests haemoglobin, ferritin, iron and TIBC together, which gives a far more accurate picture than haemoglobin alone.
5. Is fasting required for TruHealth Active Female?
Yes, a 10 to 12 hour overnight fast is required. Fasting is essential for accurate lipid profile, fasting glucose and insulin readings, all of which are affected by recent food intake. Plain water is allowed and recommended during the fasting window. Continue your regular prescription medication unless your doctor advises otherwise. Avoid alcohol for 24 hours and heavy exercise for 12 hours before the sample is drawn, as both can temporarily alter liver enzymes and other readings.
6. At what age should Indian women start taking a full body checkup?
Indian women should begin annual preventive health checkups from age 25, especially with sedentary jobs, irregular cycles, family history of thyroid disorder, diabetes or PCOS, or a BMI above 25. From age 35, additional markers like Vitamin D, calcium and bone-health indicators become particularly important. The TruHealth Active Female package is designed for exactly this profile, combining metabolic, hormonal and nutritional screening in a single blood draw.
7. Can I take the TruHealth Active Female test during my period?
You can, but a few parameters may be affected. Haemoglobin and ferritin can read slightly lower during menstruation, and inflammatory markers may be marginally elevated. For the most accurate results, ideally schedule the test for the week after your period ends. If your booking is urgent or your cycle is irregular, going ahead is still fine — just inform the phlebotomist so the result can be interpreted correctly by your physician.

After booking on bookmytest.co.in, a trained female phlebotomist (on request) arrives at your address in a 2-hour slot of your choosing, ideally between 6 AM and 10 AM for fasting samples. There are no hidden charges for the phlebotomist visit, report generation or digital delivery anywhere in India.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What makes the Metropolis TruHealth Expert Female the most advanced womens checkup in India?
The Expert Female package is the top tier in the Metropolis TruHealth series, built for Indian women aged 35 and above who want depth rather than just coverage. Beyond the standard heart, liver, kidney and thyroid panels, it adds advanced cancer-screening markers, an allergy panel, expanded hormonal indicators, inflammatory markers and detailed bone-health assessment in a single 90+ parameter sample. It is the closest equivalent to a corporate executive health check, but bookable individually online through bookmytest.co.in with free home collection.
2. Does the Metropolis Expert Female package include cancer screening?
Yes, the package includes advanced cancer-screening biomarkers relevant to Indian women, helping flag early biological changes long before symptoms appear. These markers are not a diagnosis on their own — they work as an early-warning layer alongside clinical examinations like mammography and Pap smear, both of which should still be done separately as per age guidelines. Women with a family history of breast, ovarian or cervical cancer benefit the most from this annual screening combination.
3. Which allergy parameters are tested in the Expert Female package?
The Metropolis TruHealth Expert Female package includes an allergy screening panel that helps identify whether unexplained symptoms — chronic skin rash, recurrent sinus issues, persistent cough, food sensitivities, joint pain or gut discomfort — could be allergy-driven rather than infection-driven. This is increasingly relevant for Indian women aged 35+, where allergic and autoimmune presentations rise sharply. Specific allergen testing can then be ordered as a follow-up based on which broad category is flagged.
4. How does this package help women going through perimenopause and menopause?
Perimenopause typically begins between 38 and 45 in Indian women and brings symptoms like irregular periods, sleep disruption, mood changes, weight gain, hair fall, fatigue and palpitations — often confused with thyroid disorder or stress. The Expert Female package screens thyroid, key hormones, iron, Vitamin D, calcium and cardiac risk markers together, which is the exact combination needed to differentiate perimenopausal changes from other treatable conditions. Annual testing through this phase is strongly advised.
5. Is the Metropolis Expert Female package suitable as an executive or corporate health check?
Yes. The 90+ parameter depth, NABL-accredited Metropolis processing and free home collection make this package directly comparable to executive health checks priced two to three times higher at hospital-based diagnostic centres. Senior professionals, founders and women in leadership roles use it as an annual baseline because it can be done at home over a weekend without taking time off, and the digital report is ready within 48 hours for sharing with a personal physician.
6. How often should the Expert Female checkup be repeated?
Annually for most women aged 35+, and every six months for women with a confirmed family history of cancer, autoimmune disease, diabetes or thyroid disorder, or those on long-term medication for hypertension, PCOS or hormonal therapy. The value of the Expert Female package compounds with repetition — a single report shows your current state, but two to three reports over consecutive years reveal trends in hormonal balance, bone density indicators, inflammation and metabolic markers that no one-time test can show.
7. What signs indicate I should upgrade from a basic checkup to the Expert Female?
Persistent fatigue despite normal basic reports, recurrent infections, unexplained weight changes, irregular cycles after age 35, family history of cancer or autoimmune disease, post-pregnancy symptoms that have not resolved, suspected hormonal imbalance, or any "everything is normal but I dont feel well" situation. Basic packages screen for common deficiencies; the Expert Female package screens for the deeper, often-missed causes — hormonal, allergic, autoimmune and inflammatory — that explain why symptoms persist when standard reports look fine.
8. Will Metropolis provide a doctor consultation with the Expert Female report?
Yes, a complimentary specialist consultation is typically included with the Metropolis TruHealth Expert Female package booked through bookmytest.co.in. Given the depth of parameters — especially hormonal, cancer-screening and allergy markers — interpretation by a qualified physician is strongly recommended rather than self-reading. The consultation helps you understand which borderline values matter, which require lifestyle correction, and which need a follow-up specialist referral to a gynaecologist, endocrinologist or oncologist.
9. Can the Expert Female package replace a gynaecological examination?
No, and it is important to be clear about this. The Metropolis TruHealth Expert Female package is a powerful blood-and-urine-based screening tool, but it does not replace clinical examinations like a Pap smear, pelvic exam, breast clinical examination, mammography, transvaginal ultrasound or bone-density DEXA scan. The ideal preventive strategy combines this annual blood panel with the imaging and clinical tests your gynaecologist recommends based on your age, history and findings.
10. How is pricing decided for the Metropolis TruHealth Expert Female on bookmytest.co.in?
Pricing on bookmytest.co.in reflects Metropoliss official partner rate for the TruHealth Expert Female package and is consistent across all serviceable Indian pincodes — there is no surge pricing by city. The price includes free home sample collection by a trained Metropolis phlebotomist, central laboratory processing at the NABL-accredited Metropolis facility, digital report delivery on email and WhatsApp, and a complimentary doctor consultation. The live, current price is always shown on the package page before booking confirmation.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is the Metropolis TruHealth Vital Plus package?
Metropolis TruHealth Vital Plus is a foundational annual health checkup designed for working Indian adults who want a reliable vital-organ screening without going into premium-tier depth. It evaluates 60+ parameters in a single blood and urine sample, focusing on the systems most affected by modern lifestyle — heart, liver, kidney, thyroid, blood sugar, complete blood count and Vitamin D. The package is processed at Metropolis Healthcares NABL-accredited laboratory and bookable online through bookmytest.co.in.
2. Is TruHealth Vital Plus a unisex package or only for one gender?
The Metropolis TruHealth Vital Plus is a unisex package suitable for both Indian men and women aged 25 to 45. It focuses on lifestyle-related vital-organ screening that applies equally across genders, which makes it especially practical for couples, working spouses or family members who want to book together at the same time and slot. For gender-specific concerns like testosterone, PSA in men or detailed hormonal and iron screening in women, the Active Male or Active Female packages are more appropriate.
3. How is Vital Plus different from the basic TruHealth Vital package?
The TruHealth Vital package covers core organ-function basics, while the Vital Plus tier adds additional parameters — typically Vitamin D, expanded thyroid coverage, complete urine examination and a deeper lipid breakdown — taking the total to roughly 60+ parameters. The "Plus" upgrade is meaningful for Indian adults because Vitamin D deficiency, fatty liver and subclinical hypothyroidism are extremely common but invisible on a basic panel. For most first-time annual testers, Vital Plus is the better starting point.
4. Is the Vital Plus package suitable for someone taking their first annual blood test?
Yes, the Metropolis TruHealth Vital Plus is one of the most beginner-friendly annual checkups available in India. It covers the most clinically relevant parameters at this life stage, the report is colour-coded for easy interpretation, and a complimentary doctor consultation is included with most bookings on bookmytest.co.in to help you understand any flagged values. It is widely chosen by people in their late 20s and early 30s taking their first preventive blood test after starting full-time work.
5. Can a working couple book TruHealth Vital Plus together with home sample collection?
Yes, couples and family members can book multiple Metropolis TruHealth Vital Plus packages in a single home-visit slot, which is one of the most common booking patterns on bookmytest.co.in. The Metropolis phlebotomist collects all samples in one visit, typically scheduled between 6 AM and 10 AM for the fasting requirement, and individual digital reports are delivered separately to each registered mobile number within 24 to 48 hours. This saves time and is a popular option for couples doing annual wellness together.
6. Why is Metropolis TruHealth Vital Plus called a "vital organs" checkup?
The package is built around the bodys vital organ systems — the heart (via lipid profile and HsCRP), liver (via SGPT, SGOT, bilirubin), kidney (via creatinine, urea, eGFR), thyroid (via TSH, T3, T4), pancreas (via fasting glucose and HbA1c), and blood-forming system (via complete blood count). It also assesses Vitamin D status, which influences bone, immunity and energy. Together these define the "vital" baseline of how well the bodys most critical systems are functioning, which is why this package is widely used for annual screening.
7. How does Vital Plus compare with a typical hospital pre-employment or insurance checkup?
A hospital-conducted pre-employment or basic insurance checkup usually covers 30 to 40 parameters and is priced significantly higher because of consultation, facility and overhead costs. The Metropolis TruHealth Vital Plus delivers 60+ parameters with a comparable or wider clinical scope, processed at a NABL-accredited central lab, with the convenience of home collection and digital reporting. For Indian working professionals who already have insurance but want a deeper personal annual baseline, Vital Plus is a more clinically useful and cost-efficient option.
8. Can the Vital Plus package detect early fatty liver, pre-diabetes or thyroid issues?
Yes. The liver function panel in Vital Plus can flag elevated SGPT and SGOT levels that often indicate early non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD), which is now extremely common in Indian adults with sedentary lifestyles. The HbA1c and fasting glucose readings together identify pre-diabetes well before overt diabetes develops. The thyroid panel detects subclinical hypothyroidism — a very common silent condition in Indian adults. Catching any of these at the early stage often means lifestyle correction alone can reverse the trend.
9. What does the Vital Plus package not cover, and when should I upgrade?
Vital Plus does not include male-specific markers like testosterone or PSA, female-specific hormonal panels, advanced cancer-screening markers, allergy testing or detailed iron studies. If you are above 35, have a strong family history of cancer, diabetes, heart disease or thyroid disorder, are planning pregnancy, are in perimenopause, or have unexplained chronic symptoms, you should upgrade to the gender-specific Active, ProActive or Expert tier. Vital Plus is intentionally focused — it is the essential adult baseline, not the deepest screening.
10. How fast is the Metropolis TruHealth Vital Plus report, and is doctor consultation included?
Reports are delivered within 24 hours of sample pickup, emailed and sent on WhatsApp, and downloadable anytime from the bookmytest.co.in dashboard or Metropolis TruHealth portal using your registered mobile number. A complimentary doctor consultation is typically included with bookings on bookmytest.co.in, which is particularly helpful for first-time testers who want a qualified physician to walk them through any borderline or out-of-range values rather than self-interpreting the report.

Frequently Asked Questions (FAQ's):
1. What is the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female package?
The Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female is an advanced preventive health checkup designed for Indian women aged 30 and above, especially those with a family history of illness or a higher lifestyle risk profile. It evaluates 80+ parameters in a single blood and urine sample, covering heart, liver, kidney, thyroid, diabetes, anaemia, bone health, hormonal balance, key vitamins and cancer-screening markers. The package is processed at Metropolis Healthcares NABL-accredited laboratory and bookable online with free home collection through bookmytest.co.in.
2. What tests are included in Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female?
The TruHealth ProActive Female package by Metropolis includes Complete Blood Count (CBC), Lipid Profile, Liver Function Test (LFT), Kidney Function Test (KFT), Thyroid Profile (T3, T4, TSH), HbA1c and Fasting Blood Sugar, Vitamin D 25-Hydroxy, Vitamin B12, Iron Studies, Calcium, HsCRP for cardiac inflammation, hormonal markers and a complete Urine Routine examination. The exact 80+ parameter list, normal ranges and sample Metropolis report are visible on the package page on bookmytest.co.in before booking.
3. How is ProActive Female different from the regular Active Female package?
The ProActive Female package is the upgraded, more comprehensive version of the Active Female checkup. While the Active Female covers around 70 parameters focused on core metabolic and nutritional health, the ProActive Female adds extra cancer-screening markers, expanded hormonal panels, deeper cardiac risk assessment and additional bone-health indicators — taking the total to 80+ parameters. It is recommended for women above 30, women with a family history of cancer, diabetes or thyroid disease, and those wanting a deeper annual screening.
4. Why is this Metropolis package recommended for Indian women?
Indian women face a unique combination of high hypothyroidism prevalence, widespread iron-deficiency anaemia, very high Vitamin D deficiency, early-onset metabolic syndrome and rising rates of breast and cervical cancer. The Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female package is curated by Metropolis pathologists to screen exactly these high-prevalence conditions in a single sample. It is particularly valuable for women with a family history of cancer, diabetes, thyroid disorder or heart disease, and for women approaching perimenopause.
5. Is fasting required for the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female test?
Yes, a 10 to 12 hour overnight fast is required. Fasting is essential for accurate lipid profile, fasting glucose and insulin readings, which are directly affected by recent food intake. Plain water is allowed and recommended during the fasting window. Continue your prescription medication unless your doctor specifies otherwise. Avoid alcohol for 24 hours and heavy exercise for 12 hours before the Metropolis phlebotomist arrives, as both can temporarily alter liver enzymes and other key readings.
6. Can I take the Metropolis ProActive Female test during my period?
You can, but a few parameters may be affected. Haemoglobin and ferritin readings can be marginally lower during menstruation, and inflammatory markers like HsCRP may be slightly elevated. For the most accurate results, schedule the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female test for the week after your period ends. If your cycle is irregular or your booking is time-sensitive, proceeding is still fine — just inform the phlebotomist so the report can be interpreted accurately by your physician.
7. At what age should Indian women take the ProActive Female checkup?
The Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female package is ideal for Indian women from age 30 onwards, especially with a family history of illness, sedentary work, irregular cycles, BMI above 25 or post-pregnancy. From age 40, with menopause approaching, the expanded hormonal and bone-health panels become particularly valuable. Annual repeat testing helps build a personal baseline so subtle drift in TSH, ferritin, HbA1c or Vitamin D is caught early and treated before it progresses to clinical disease.
8. How long does it take to get the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female report?
Reports are delivered within 24 hours of sample pickup. Samples collected in the early morning slot typically reach the Metropolis processing laboratory the same day, with digital reports emailed and sent on WhatsApp by the next evening. A few specialised parameters like Vitamin B12 or certain hormonal markers may need an additional 12 hours. You can also download the report anytime from your bookmytest.co.in dashboard or the Metropolis TruHealth portal using your registered mobile number.
9. Is Metropolis a trusted lab for preventive checkups in India?
Yes. Metropolis Healthcare is among Indias most respected diagnostic chains, operating NABL-accredited and ISO-certified laboratories, with a senior panel of pathologists and decades of clinical reputation. The TruHealth series is designed in-house by Metropolis specialists and is widely used in corporate wellness, insurance health checks and individual preventive care across India. Booking the Metropolis TruHealth ProActive Female through bookmytest.co.in gives you the same lab quality with transparent partner pricing and zero hidden home-collection charges.
10. Is home sample collection available across India for this package?
Yes, free home sample collection by trained Metropolis phlebotomists is available across 2,000+ pincodes covering all major metro cities, tier-2 cities and most tier-3 towns in India. After booking on bookmytest.co.in, a female phlebotomist (on request) arrives at your address in a 2-hour slot of your choosing, ideally between 6 AM and 10 AM for fasting samples. There are no extra charges for the visit, report generation or digital delivery — pricing remains transparent across the country.
